pr_title: refactor: improve rank implementation, especially around nulls

issue_context.title: `.rank()` panics when `pl.Utf8` series contains `null`
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

Ranking strings panics if a null value is present:
```python
pl.Series([None, "", "z", "a"]).rank()  # panics: InvalidOperation(ErrString("fill-null strategy MaxBound is not supported"))
```

Ranking other dtypes (e.g. ints) behaves correctly:
```python
pl.Series([None, 30, 20, 9]).rank()
#shape: (4,)
#Series: '' [f64]
# [
# 	null
# 	3.0
# 	2.0
# 	1.0
# ]
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

Rank panics on string data - only if a null value is present.

### Expected behavior

`.rank()` on strings should behave exactly like ranking integers or other dtypes with regard to null-handling.
